A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Your questions.
Clear answers.

Get familiar with the essentials
before you choose a service.

What is credit score monitoring?

Credit monitoring tracks specified changes in covered credit files and can send alerts. The exact coverage and timing depend on the plan.

Will checking my own credit score lower it?

Checking your own credit is generally a soft inquiry and does not lower your score. Applications for new credit may involve a hard inquiry.

Do I need monitoring from all three credit bureaus?

Different bureaus can hold different information. Consider your needs and review the plan’s coverage before deciding whether broader monitoring is useful.

Can credit monitoring prevent identity theft?

Monitoring can help flag certain changes, but it cannot prevent every form of identity theft or guarantee that fraud will be detected.

How are the providers on this site selected?

This site currently uses fictional sample providers. No real provider rankings or scores are published. Final selections require verified evidence and an approved methodology.
